## Orientation

Work only in ~/se-workflow on branch feat/dashboard-ui (HEAD 35023e7). The commit loader is `load_commit` and the screen is `CommitScreen` in `scripts/dashboard_app.py`; git runs as an argv list with cwd = repo root in a thread worker. Keep changes to that screen and its tests. The known redraw flake in the detail screen is a separate task; if it fails, re-run it alone and report, do not fix it here.
